item.title: No answers, only questions: Murder of Brian Pettinger
item.description: More than 35 years ago, 10 On Your Side first raised the question in the Brian Pettinger murder case that, whether due to proximity to the other victims and the close timing of the murders, Pettinger, who was murdered in 1987, must be considered as part of the Colonial Parkway murders.

item.title: ODU ROTC cadets awarded Purple Hearts, meritorious service medals
